title: Rosalind and the Choir
author: R. M. Oyelaran
blurb: Rosalind Hartwell, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has spent five years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the long winter finishes falling.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
